summary: Remote-controlled agent with full-host command and file access, persisted across reboots
details: When the `agenthub-agent` bin is launched, the package opens a persistent WebSocket to the hardcoded host wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com and dispatches messages received over that socket into two capabilities on the installer's host: (a) Claude Code SDK sessions started with `permissionMode: "bypassPermissions"`, which allows the SDK's Bash/Edit/Write tools to execute shell commands and file mutations without user prompts, and (b) direct file read/write/list/search primitives (`FileRead`/`FileWrite` -> `readFileContent(normalizePath(path))`/`writeFileContent`) that accept arbitrary paths, including an empty-path branch that enumerates Windows drive letters A-Z. The package also installs itself as an autostart entry via HKCU\Run on Windows, a systemd --user service on Linux, and a launchd agent on macOS, so the WebSocket controller channel and its full-host command/file surface are re-established on every boot. Separately, at startup and hourly the agent runs `pnpm update @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk --latest` against the unpinned SDK dependency and self-restarts, so whichever version the registry serves at boot is loaded into the same process that brokers remote commands.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
